caption: The drawing depicts a circular design resembling a decorative plate or medallion with a border made up of a brown pattern, encircled by a dotted edge. Within the confines of the circle, there is a central image showing a person riding a horse. The person is wearing a helmet and a red-brown garment, and they are holding a curved sword in their right hand and what appears to be a staff or spear in their left. The person’s pants are green with a dotted pattern, and they have black footwear. The horse is depicted in mid-stride with all four legs extended. Around the horse and rider, there are stylized plant motifs: two green leafy plants at the bottom and a branch with leaves extending upward to the right. The background of the medallion is a light tan or beige, and the artwork uses mostly earthy tones, including browns, reds, greens, and some black for outlining. The artist's signature, "JACK CARR," appears in blue in the lower right corner outside the circular design, on the tan paper background.
title: Pa. German Pie Plate
